# Rules

Everything this app's UI must not do, in one place. Read it before writing UI. A rule marked "review" has no script yet, so a reviewer checks it.

| ID | Rule | Answered on | Ground | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rule/button-canonical` | When a surface needs a button, call button rather than painting a fill, because the inventory counted 3 hand-painted ghost buttons with 3 radii and 3 hover fills. | [components/button](docs/generated/system/components/button.md) | app | review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs |
| `rule/button-focus` | When a button has keyboard focus, paint the FOCUS_OUTLINE_W (1px) ring at FOCUS_OUTLINE_OFFSET (-1), because .cursor-button.tab-focusable:focus is outline:1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset:-1px. | [components/button](docs/generated/system/components/button.md) | measured | review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs |
| `rule/button-recipe` | When a button is drawn, use RADIUS_CONTROL (2px), BUTTON_PAD_X (8px), BUTTON_PAD_Y (4px) and FONT_BUTTON (14px), because .cursor-button measures border-radius:2px; font-size:14px; gap:4px; padding:4px 8px and the app's 6/8/10/12 scale came from a third-party clone. | [components/button](docs/generated/system/components/button.md) | measured | review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs |
| `rule/button-states` | When a button is hovered, pressed or disabled, use HOVER_OPACITY (0.8) and DISABLED_OPACITY (0.5), because .cursor-button-primary-clickable:not(.disabled):hover is opacity:.8 and .cursor-button-primary.disabled is opacity:.5. | [components/button](docs/generated/system/components/button.md) | measured | review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs |

## What the check can't see

A reviewer or a browser covers these. Passing `cargo xtask system-check` says nothing about them.

- the rendered result: contrast, optical size and spacing are not measured.
- a control drawn by hand from tokens, with no literal left to see: the check reads values, not shapes.
- a value that matches no token or constant today: the check freezes it in the ratchet, it does not bless it.
- literals after a `//` on the same line, and code below a file's first `mod tests`.
- files outside `crates/ui-egui/src`.
